title: AI QA Engineer
description:
**Experience:** 5+ Years

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

We are looking for an AI QA Engineer to work across Quality Engineering, Test Automation, Generative AI and RAG-based systems. The role needs strong Java, Selenium, debugging and CI/CD skills, along with an interest in GenAI and AI-driven QA automation.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Analyze CI/JIT pipeline failures, find root causes and work with developers to fix recurring issues.
* Develop and maintain automated test scripts and frameworks using Java and Selenium.
* Build and maintain AI-assisted test case and test script generation, including RAG-based QA workflows.
* Run POCs to evaluate new QA tools and technologies before adoption.
* Support product teams with automation scripts, and update them as the application changes.
* Automate repetitive testing activities and improve the reliability and coverage of the automation framework.
* Collaborate with developers, QA and product teams, and document test processes, frameworks and POCs.

**REQUIRED SKILLS**

* **Test Automation:** Java, Selenium WebDriver, functional and regression testing, building and maintaining frameworks, debugging failed tests.
* **CI/CD:** Analyzing pipeline failures and identifying whether the cause is the application, test script, infrastructure or pipeline configuration.
* **AI / GenAI:** Understanding of Generative AI and LLM applications, basic to intermediate RAG knowledge, interest in AI-assisted testing.
* **General QA:** Test case design, execution and defect identification, with sound testing principles.
* Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to investigate root causes independently.

**GOOD TO HAVE**

* RAG pipelines or AI agents, LLM APIs, Python or other scripting.
* Git/GitHub/GitLab; Jenkins, GitHub Actions or GitLab CI.
* Postman or REST Assured; Docker and cloud-based test environments.
* Experience building internal QA tools or automation utilities.

**EXPECTED OUTCOMES**

* More reliable automated testing pipelines and fewer recurring pipeline failures.
* Higher automation coverage and AI-powered test generation.

Pay: ₹300,000.00 - ₹600,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

title: Manual QA Tester
description:
**Job Overview**


We are looking for a detail\-oriented Manual QA Tester to execute frontend test operations with precision and consistency. This role sits at the client\-facing UI layer of a complex web onboarding workflow and is responsible for validating form behavior, field\-level validation logic, and error handling across browsers — all while following defined test runbooks and maintaining accurate, well\-documented evidence of every defect or error state encountered.
  

The primary assignment is to execute structured walkthroughs across representative onboarding personas and document the observed frontend constraints that will become inputs to downstream FSM/state\-model analysis and evidence set.
  

  

The ideal candidate thrives on process discipline and has a sharp eye for visual and functional inconsistencies in data\-entry\-heavy web applications.
  

  

**Project Details**


**Title:** Manual QA Tester \- (India)


**Rate:** $3\.5/hr


**Start Date:** 19th October


**Duration:** 3 Weeks


**Commitment:** 40 Hours per Week


**Location:** India (Remote)


**Job Type:** Freelance (with the possibility of full time employment based on performance and project needs in all opportunity)

**Responsibilities**

* Execute test cases strictly in accordance with documented test runbooks, ensuring no steps are skipped or altered without approval
* Perform cross\-browser UI testing to validate layout, functionality, and boundary conditions across supported browsers and devices
* Validate client\-side form field rules such as character\-length limits, format/pattern (regex\-style) validation, and required\-field enforcement across form inputs (e.g., text fields, dropdowns, radio buttons)
* Verify UI state behavior driven by validation outcomes — for example, error banners appearing on malformed input, or action buttons remaining disabled until all fields pass validation
* Identify, capture, and log DOM\-level screenshots and error states with clear, reproducible documentation
* Track and report test execution status, flagging deviations from expected runbook outcomes
* Maintain organized records of test evidence (screenshots, logs, error traces) for defect tracking and audit purposes
* Escalate boundary and edge\-case UI failures to senior QA or development teams with sufficient supporting detail
* Collaborate with QA leads to refine and update test runbooks based on recurring issues or coverage gaps
* Execute structured walkthroughs across the defined onboarding personas.
* Document observed UI constraints, field limits, regex/pattern behaviour, conditional states, error states, and decision points.
* Consolidate findings into a structured frontend constraint dictionary and evidence set for downstream FSM validation.
* Maintain traceability between each observed behaviour, persona, test step, and captured evidence.

**Required Qualifications**

* Proven experience in manual QA testing, preferably in a frontend/UI\-focused environment involving multi\-field forms
* Demonstrated ability to strictly follow and execute structured test runbooks
* Hands\-on experience with cross\-browser testing tools and techniques (e.g., BrowserStack, native browser dev tools)
* Working knowledge of DOM structure and browser developer tools for inspecting and capturing error states
* Familiarity with client\-side validation concepts (field length limits, format/regex validation, conditional UI states)
* Strong attention to detail and disciplined documentation habits
* Basic understanding of UI/UX boundary conditions and how they manifest as defects
* Good written communication skills for clear, reproducible bug reporting
* Ability to produce structured evidence that can be reviewed and reused by senior QA/SDET resources.
* Experience testing complex onboarding, registration, account\-creation, or other multi\-step workflows is preferred.

title: Lead Software Development Engineer in Test
description:
**Overview**


We are seeking a Lead SDET (Software Development Engineer in Test ) to provide end\-to\-end technical governance across all QA layers — frontend, middleware, and backend — for a complex, multi\-layered onboarding platform. This role owns the architecture of API contract testing and the data modeling of complex entity relationships (e.g., hierarchical/parent\-child style structures), while ensuring that quality assumptions made at one layer (such as client\-side validation) are independently verified at every downstream layer rather than trusted at face value. The ideal candidate combines strong technical leadership with the ability to set and enforce delivery governance across cross\-functional teams.


**MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Provide technical governance across frontend, middleware, and backend testing layers.
* Establish and enforce QA delivery standards, evidence requirements, review processes, and quality gates.
* Review frontend constraint dictionaries and FSM/state\-model outputs for completeness and consistency.
* Review API schema reconstructions, network evidence, and tracer replay outputs for technical quality and traceability.
* Coordinate with QA Analysts, SDETs, and Test Operations Associates to align technical execution with delivery timelines.
* Review test architecture decisions, validation approaches, and coverage strategies.
* Coordinate dependency resolution, evidence rework, and cross\-layer reconciliation throughout the engagement.
* Act as the escalation point for cross\-layer technical discrepancies and evidence\-quality issues.
* Compile and quality\-check the raw technical evidence dossiers produced by the workstreams.
* Identify evidence gaps, inconsistencies, or areas requiring rework before handoff to client stakeholders.
* Report on delivery health, technical risks, evidence quality, dependencies, and unresolved gaps.
* Prepare the technical evidence package for handoff to the client team responsible for final modelling and logic\-gap assessment.
* Support technical readout preparation by ensuring that findings are traceable to empirical evidence.

**Project Details**

**Title**: Lead SDET **Rate:** $17/hr  

**Start Date:** 19th October  

**Duration:** 4 Months  

**Commitment:** 22 Hours per Week  

**Location:** India (Remote)  

**Job Type:** Contractual (with the possibility of a Full\-time employment extension based on performance and project needs)

**QUALIFICATIONS:**


* Proven experience of 8\+ years in a QA leadership role spanning multiple testing layers (frontend, middleware, backend)
* Demonstrated expertise in API contract testing architecture and governance
* Practical experience with knowledge graph or entity\-relationship data modeling and its application to test/data traceability
* Strong understanding of layered system architectures and the importance of independently verifying quality at each layer rather than relying on upstream assumptions
* Strong track record of technical delivery governance, including setting standards and quality gates
* Excellent cross\-functional leadership and stakeholder communication skills
* Deep technical grounding across QA disciplines (manual, automation, systems\-level testing) to credibly guide teams at every layer
* Experience mentoring or managing SDETs and QA Analysts
* Experience leading complex multi\-week technical QA, API validation, or security\-assessment engagements is strongly preferred.
* Experience establishing evidence/traceability models across complex technical workflows is preferred.
* Familiarity with knowledge graphs, entity\-relationship models, or structured technical dependency/evidence modeling is preferred; deep knowledge\-graph engineering expertise is not required.
* Ability to synthesize technical evidence into concise stakeholder\-ready findings and handoff materials.

title: Senior Quality Assurance Analyst
description:
### **A****BOUT TIDE**



At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting.



Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, India, Germany and France.



Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love.


**Tide facts:**


* Tide is available for UK, Indian, German and French SMEs
* Over 2 million members across UK and India
* Over $300 million raised in funding
* Over 2,800 Tideans globally
* Recognised with Great Place to Work certification three years in a row, and among India's Top 50 Best Workplaces in Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance in 2026
* We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg
### **ABOUT THE TEAM:**



As a Senior Quality Assurance (QA) Analyst at Tide, you will play an important role in our first line of defense team ensuring both compliance and enhancing the sales performance of our products. Your expertise in risk management and compliance will help ensure that controls and policies are in place to mitigate risks, safeguarding our members and Business. A natural investigator, you will dive into cases to uncover root causes of defects, identify trends, and develop data\-driven solutions.



Your focus will be on reviewing and analyzing customer interactions, escalated cases, and operational processes across the UK, India, and Germany. By leveraging root cause and trend analyses, you will deliver actionable insights and recommendations to management and key stakeholders. These insights will aim to enhance customer outcomes, reduce risks, and ensure adherence to regulatory standards.

### **ABOUT THE ROLE:**


**Consumer Duty \& Compliance:**


* Understand Consumer Duty initiatives by ensuring QA activities promote fairness, transparency, and positive customer outcomes.
* Review and test policies and procedures to confirm their effectiveness in ensuring consistent and fair customer interactions.

**Quality Assurance \& Monitoring:**


* Conduct quality reviews of customer interactions, escalations, trends, and complaints to ensure alignment with company policies, regulatory standards (including Consumer Duty), and customer satisfaction.
* Use data\-driven insights to analyze quality metrics and sales performance.
* Monitor agent interactions to identify recurring issues, ensuring compliance with financial regulations and promoting fair treatment.


**Risk Management \& Process Improvement:**


* Identify potential risks or breaches and provide actionable solutions to mitigate regulatory or reputational issues.
* Perform root cause analysis to address recurring issues and trends in customer interactions, enhancing quality and improving processes.
* Enhance QA scorecards to drive performance improvements and better outcomes.


**Coaching \& Feedback:**


* Deliver coaching sessions and actionable feedback to improve agent performance.
* Identify learning gaps and process inefficiencies, providing recommendations to address negative trends.


**Reporting \& Stakeholder Communication:**


* Create and deliver detailed monthly QA reports for senior stakeholders, highlighting team data, insights, risks, and recommendations for improvements.
* Collaborate with internal teams to implement policy and process changes based on QA evaluations.


**Additional Responsibilities:**


* Facilitate new joiner onboarding and oversee QA evaluations during new team members' probation periods.
* Lead calibration sessions and participate in QA meetings with second\-line teams to implement actions that mitigate risk.
* Strong communication and writing skills are essential for presenting findings, preparing reports, and creating training materials and sales scripts.


### **WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR:**


**Experience \& Knowledge:**


* A minimum of 2\+ years of experience in Quality Assurance (QA) or a related role.
* Expertise in QA responsibilities, with a solid understanding of risk, compliance, and sales within financial services.
* Knowledge of Consumer Duty and FCA regulatory frameworks in the UK.
* Familiarity with QA testing tools and methodologies.
* Comprehensive knowledge of financial services sales processes.


**Skills \& Competencies:**


* Strong communication skills, with the ability to present insights and recommendations to stakeholders at all levels.
* Exceptional problem\-solving and decision\-making abilities, with a proactive and detail\-oriented mindset.
* Expertise in enhancing QA scorecards to improve overall performance.
* Ability to analyze data and generate insights that drive continuous improvement.
* Excellent presentation skills to clearly communicate findings and recommendations.
* Skilled in providing coaching and feedback to support a high\-performing sales team.


**Technical Proficiency:**


* Proficiency in Google Sheets, Microsoft Office, and Jira.
* Familiarity with Looker is a plus (but not essential).


**Cultural \& Collaborative Fit:**


* Strong understanding of risks associated with sales in regulated industries in the UK.
* Ability to evaluate and refine processes for compliance and operational efficiency.
* Experience collaborating with internal teams to implement automation and improve performance.
* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced, target\-driven environment.
* Ability to work across different teams, including Risk and Compliance, ensuring alignment with policies and regulations.


**Additional Attributes:**


* Self\-motivated, proactive, and a strong analytical thinker.
* Strong time management skills and multitasking abilities.
* Able to understand local regulatory standards and cultural nuances.


### **WHAT YOU'LL GET IN RETURN:**


* Competitive salary
* Self \& Family Health Insurance
* Term \& Life Insurance
* OPD Benefits
* Mental wellbeing through Plumm
* Learning \& Development Budget
* WFH Setup allowance
* 24 days Annual leaves
* Family \& Friendly Leaves
* WOO policy allows remote work for up to 90 days a year

### **TIDEAN WAYS OF WORKING**



At Tide, we champion a **flexible workplace** model thatsupports both in\-person and remote work to cater to the specific needs of our different teams.



While remote work is supported, we believe in the power of face\-to\-face interactions to foster team spirit and collaboration. Our offices are designed as hubs for innovation and team\-building, where we encourage regular in\-person gatherings to foster a strong sense of community.

### **TIDE IS A PLACE FOR EVERYONE**



At Tide, we believe that we can only succeed if we let our differences enrich our culture. Our Tideans come from a variety of backgrounds and experience levels. We consider everyone irrespective of their ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran, neurodiversity or differently\-abled status. We celebrate diversity in our workforce as a cornerstone of our success. Our commitment to a broad spectrum of ideas and backgrounds is what enables us to build products that resonate with our members' diverse needs and lives.



We are One Team and foster a transparent and inclusive environment, where everyone's voice is heard.

  


*At Tide, we thrive on diversity, embracing various backgrounds and experiences. We welcome all individuals regardless of ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, or disability. Our inclusive culture is key to our success, helping us build products that meet our members' diverse needs. We are One Team, committed to transparency and ensuring everyone's voice is heard.*

  


**Disclaimer**

*It has come to our attention that individuals or agencies are falsely claiming to represent Tide and are reaching out to candidates regarding job opportunities. Please be aware that:*
* *Tide does* ***not*** *charge any fees at any stage of the recruitment process.*
* *All official Tide job opportunities are listed exclusively on our* ***Careers Page*** *and applications should be submitted through this channel.*
* *Communication from Tide will only come from an official* ***@tide******.co*** *email address.*
* *Tide does not work with agencies or recruiters without prior formal engagement, and we do not authorize third parties to make job offers on our behalf.*


*If you are contacted by anyone misrepresenting Tide or requesting payment, please treat it as fraudulent and report it to us immediately at* *talent@tide.co*  

*Your safety and trust are important to us, and we are committed to ensuring a fair and transparent recruitment process.*

  


*Tide leverages AI to enhance our hiring experience. You can read more about how we use AI in our recruitment process in our* *AI Policy**.*


*Your personal data will be processed by Tide for recruitment purposes and in accordance with* *Tide's Recruitment Privacy Notice**.*

ETS is a global education and talent solutions organization enabling lifelong learners worldwide to be future\-ready. For more than 75 years, we've been advancing the science of measurement to build benchmarks for fair and valid skill assessment across cultures and borders. Our worldwide impact extends through our renowned assessments including TOEFL®, TOEIC®, GRE® and Praxis® tests, serving millions of learners in more than 200 countries and territories. Through strategic acquisitions, we've expanded our global capabilities: PSI strengthens our workforce assessment solutions, while Edusoft, Kira Talent, Pipplet, Vericant, and Wheebox enhance our educational technology and assessment platforms across critical markets worldwide.
Through ETS Research Institute and ETS Solutions, we're partnering with educational institutions, governments, and organizations globally to promote skill proficiency, empower upward mobility, and unlock opportunities for everyone, everywhere. This role provides knowledge and support for application testing, testing automation, performance testing and continuous improvements.

* Log, track, and manage issues, bugs, and enhancements.

* Work with development teams to understand root causes and implement fixes.

* Adhere to ethical standards and comply with the laws and regulations applicable to your job function.

* Excellent communication and attention to detail in fast paced cross\-group development.
* Ability to Coordinate with multiple teams during test definition and execution.

description:
**Job Summary**

We are seeking an experienced Senior QA Automation Engineer with 5\+ years of experience, including a strong track record in fintech/NBFC projects, to lead quality assurance efforts for our in house lending platform, compliance modules, and financial risk systems. This role goes beyond test execution – you will own the automation strategy, mentor junior QA engineers, and drive quality standards across a fast\-paced fintech environment. You will work closely with developers, product managers, and business stakeholders to reduce defects, accelerate releases, and strengthen overall product reliability.

**Key Responsibilities** 

* Own and drive the end\-to\-end test automation strategy for web and mobile applications in the NBFC domain.
* Design, build, and maintain scalable automation frameworks using Selenium WebDriver, Appium, or similar tools, integrated with CI/CD pipelines such as Jenkins or GitHub Actions.
* Architect and enhance test automation frameworks to improve coverage, stability, and execution speed.
* Lead functional, regression, performance, and API testing efforts using tools like Postman and REST Assured for backend services handling financial transactions. Mentor and guide junior QA engineers on automation best practices, framework standards, and code quality.
* Define and drive test strategy, test planning, and release sign\-off criteria for agile sprints.
* Analyze test results and defect trends, lead root cause analysis, and drive continuous improvement in product reliability.
* Partner with developers and product managers from design stage onward to build testability and quality checkpoints into the development lifecycle.
* Track and report quality metrics (defect density, automation coverage, release readiness) to engineering and business leadership.

**Required Qualifications \& Experience** 

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, IT, or a related field. 4\+ years of hands\-on experience in QA automation testing, including at least 1–2 years working on fintech/NBFC projects.
* Strong proficiency in Java/Python for scripting and building automation frameworks (Selenium, Appium, JUnit/TestNG).
* Proven experience designing and scaling automation frameworks from the ground up.
* Strong experience with API testing (Postman, SoapUI, REST Assured) and version control (Git).
* Strong command of SQL for database validation in financial systems.
* Prior experience mentoring or leading a small QA team is highly desirable.
* Strong Agile/Scrum experience with tools like JIRA and Confluence.
* Excellent analytical, problem\-solving, and stakeholder communication skills.

**Working Hours and Days Full Time**

* Monday to Saturday (Sat – WFH)
* 10:00 A.M. – 6:30 P.M

**Interested Candidate can share their resume on \+91 9871414201 / Anurag.Gupta@lnvstech.com**

Pay: ₹1,000,000\.00 \- ₹1,200,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person
